title: Chris vs Chris: Who's running and what's at stake this New Zealand election
summary: New Zealanders will head to the polls on 7 November to elect a new government, with rising cost of living a key concern for voters.

blocks.text: New Zealanders will head to the polls on 7 November to elect a new government. The rising cost of living, unemployment and healthcare are among the key concerns of voters.
The BBC's Australia and New Zealand correspondent, Katy Watson, explains everything you need to know.
